svg.metadata: {"story":"Enoch","act":1,"chapter":"Ch.1 · A Family Record","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The generations from Adam are recorded, and Jared fathers Enoch, who walks in a line of long-lived fathers and sons.
